queries: Phaser 3.90.0 official repository immutable revision and MIT license
Cocos Engine 3.8.8 official repository immutable revision and MIT license
Phaser virtual joystick infrastructure immutable revision and license
TapTap Mini Game Cocos Creator 3.8 adapter official documentation and license evidence

candidates.name: Phaser 3.90.0
candidates.technicalFit: Reuse only the factory-pinned Phaser runtime for the isolated browser development and QA build. It can exercise the shared pure-TypeScript simulation and responsive input, but it is not platform-package evidence and must not be represented as a WeChat, Douyin, or TapTap Mini Game adapter.
securityRisks: A browser runtime does not provide mini-game BOM/DOM adaptation or platform APIs
The production package must not depend on dynamically downloaded scripts
attributionRequirements: Preserve the Phaser MIT copyright and permission notice in third-party notices for distributed builds containing Phaser

candidates.name: Cocos Engine 3.8.8
candidates.license: MIT for the runtime engine; Cocos Creator editor terms must be reviewed separately
candidates.technicalFit: Approved production runtime candidate after the browser vertical slice passes. Cocos Creator 3.8.x has official WeChat and Douyin build flows, and TapTap documents a Cocos 3.8.x conversion plugin that produces a Tap Mini Game zip from the WeChat build.
securityRisks: Cocos Creator editor licensing is separate from the MIT runtime engine license
Platform plugins and adapters require independent version, license, and integrity verification before installation
Each platform build still requires real-device validation
attributionRequirements: Preserve the Cocos Engine MIT copyright and permission notice
Review and comply with the installed Cocos Creator editor agreement before production distribution

candidates.name: phaser3-rex-notes virtual joystick and helpers
candidates.technicalFit: The repository contains reusable Phaser input helpers, but this game already has a small tested radial drag implementation. Adding the library would increase dependency surface without improving platform portability.
securityRisks: Large helper collection creates unnecessary transitive surface for a single joystick behavior
Phaser-specific input code would be discarded during the Cocos production migration
attributionRequirements: Would require preserving the Rex MIT notice if reused

rationale: Reuse only the already pinned Phaser engine for browser development/QA and the Cocos 3.8.8 runtime as the later three-platform production target. No third-party idle-shop, supermarket, character, UI, map, economy, content, or balancing code is approved. The official TapTap Cocos conversion plugin 1.2.2 is documented but is not approved by this open-source artifact because no public immutable repository and direct license evidence were found; it must undergo a separate binary/plugin review before installation.
